mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact two-flavour chiral vacuum determinant and invariant baryon operators give a vanishing leading Dashen theta curvature, the specified e2 susceptibility logarithm, and the specified common nucleon e2 M loop; independent baryon isoscalar constant survives in individual proton response
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic expressions over positive real masses/scales and formal e2; rational quark charges
mathematics.conventions: Natural units; fixed full QCD+QED MSbar light masses at mu_q=2 GeV; positive mu,md; SU(2) F,B,Z at alpha=0, fixed strange mass; chiral subtraction matched to source eq(35); no empirical alpha used.
inputs: HB pion self-energy at chiral order p3

bounds.chiral_order: meson O(e2 p2); baryon O(e2), O(e2 p)

non_claims: No four-dimensional de Sitter c_H calculation
No alpha root or empirical alpha input
No claim that flat theta susceptibility equals a geometric H-response
No complete proton electromagnetic mass prediction

convention_details.mass_inputs: Renormalized full QCD+QED MSbar quark masses at fixed mu_q=2 GeV; derivative taken holding them fixed. No free-quark pole mass is assumed.
convention_details.chiral_parameters: F,B,Z at alpha=0, fixed strange mass; SU(2) positive light masses, theta near zero; e2=4pi alpha
convention_details.subtraction: Chiral scalar determinant finite term -1/2, matched to source eq(35); subtraction changes produce analytic local shifts only
convention_details.susceptibility: d2 E(theta)/dtheta2 at theta=0 in zero-temperature infinite flat volume
convention_details.nucleon_mass: Infinite-volume rest threshold; HB chiral expansion order p3, first order in e2 for response
convention_details.charges: Qquark=diag(2/3,-1/3); Qnucleon=diag(1,0), with e factored out in script
